description: Performs real-time (~250ms) inline operational and behavioral auditing for a single turn using Systemores System One. Evaluates required systemPrompt and userMessage (optionally paired with agentResponse and/or proposedToolCall, each max 8,000 chars) to score policy compliance, sycophancy probability, and unauthorized tool scope, returning an advisory circuit-breaker action (DISPATCH, INTERCEPT, QUARANTINE, STRIP_TOOL) for the caller to enforce. Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed scoring (variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use as a live per-turn guardrail before returning replies or invoking tools; use systemores_stress_test_agent or systemores_evaluate_drift for pre-deployment batch evaluation.

agentResponse.description: Optional proposed assistant reply text to audit against systemPrompt (max 8,000 chars). Provide agentResponse, proposedToolCall, or both for full turn inspection.

proposedToolCall.description: Optional tool invocation proposed by the agent (JSON string or 'tool_name(args)' text, max 8,000 chars) to check for unauthorized tool scope.

systemPrompt.description: The behavioral blueprint, constraints, or security policies of the agent under audit.

userMessage.description: The prompt or message sent by the user in this interaction turn.

name: systemores_audit_turn_live
title: Live Turn Audit (Systemores System One)
